notes.title: Battle Pack 2 Release Date Announced
notes.notes:
Get ready to commemorate history in the most immersive way possible as we unveil the release date for the next DLC. Combat Mission Battle for Normandy - Battle Pack 2 will be out on June 6th, 2024 - the very anniversary of D-Day.

With Battle Pack 2, players will be transported back to the heroic actions of the 4th Infantry Division and the daring maneuvers of the 101st Airborne Division, experiencing the pivotal days of the Normandy campaign firsthand. From the intense battles of June 6th to the critical junctures leading up to June 13th, 1944, you'll navigate the challenges and victories that shaped the outcome of this historic conflict.

The 13th of June holds particular significance, marking the "end of the beginning" for the Normandy campaign in this sector, as Carentan is secured and a vital linkup between the American beaches is achieved.

Don't miss your chance to be a part of this epic journey. Combat Mission Battle for Normandy - Battle Pack 2 launches on June 6th, 2024. Victory awaits.
